description: NIST's CTC-02 (rc), its base plane #9481 and one drafted boss cylinder #12501, tilted 2° off the plane's normal, as a two-face sheet. Their shared edge #9225 lies on the plane and 0.01495 off the cylinder; where the surfaces meet is 0.01496 from it, 1/sin 88° further, and the checker's S5 found them meeting there, outside the edge's tolerance. The edge's read tolerance now holds where its faces meet (ADR-0059). The read heals the gap by growing the edge's tolerance to it, and names it (ADR-0058). Open CASCADE's healed cylinder face is not the file's: its pcurve of edge #9225 lies up to 0.0347 from the edge's curve (length 13.07), where Arris's lies within the edge's 0.01496, so its area may differ by up to that band, 0.454 mm² or 4.3e-6 relative; it differs by 2.5e-6. The area and inertia tolerances are that band; the centroid's is that band times the sheet's diagonal (990) over its area, 0.0043
